## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Kilocode #14508 MCP CIMD - HIGH PRIORITY (mcp + config)

- **What**: Kilocode PR #14508 "feat(cli): support MCP client ID metadata documents" merged 2026-09-24 implemented MCP Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD, MCP protocol extension for capability/API declaration; JSON doc at `.well-known/mcp.json` served by MCP servers with protocol version, supported capabilities, deprecated/experimental APIs, security policies; clients fetch CIMD before connect, negotiate features via intersection, reject servers with incompatible protocol version; guards against feature-drift breakage where client assumes feature exists but server never shipped it, or server deprecated API but client still calls it). This is MCP capability negotiation (declarative feature surface, version/capability/deprecation metadata).

- **Why**: Alexi has MCP support (src/mcp/client.ts, mcp-servers.json registry) but no CIMD-based capability negotiation - MCP clients assume the server supports the full MCP protocol surface (tools, resources, prompts), and servers assume the client understands all responses. Kilocode's CIMD lets servers declare their actual capabilities (e.g. tools-only, no resources) and deprecation timelines (e.g. legacy prompt format deprecated 2026-12-01), and clients validate compatibility before connect (reject if protocol version mismatch, skip deprecated APIs, warn on experimental features). Reduces runtime errors (client calls unsupported API), improves forward/backward compat (gradual rollout of new features), and surfaces breaking changes early (connect fails instead of silent failure mid-session). Implementation path: add CIMD fetcher (src/mcp/cimd.ts, fetch `<server-url>/.well-known/mcp.json` before connect, parse JSON with protocol version/capabilities/deprecated APIs/experimental features), add compatibility validator (reject if protocol version incompatible, warn if deprecated APIs in use, skip unsupported capabilities), store CIMD per server (mcp-servers.json or in-memory cache), add CIMD schema (Zod schema for validation), write tests (CIMD fetch, version mismatch rejection, capability intersection, deprecated API warning).

- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14508 (Kilocode MCP CIMD support, merged 2026-09-24), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/mcp/client.ts (Alexi MCP client, no CIMD negotiation)

- **Category**: mcp + config (MCP capability negotiation, CIMD schema)

- **Size**: MEDIUM (~8-12h). Add CIMD fetcher (src/mcp/cimd.ts, fetch `.well-known/mcp.json` from server URL before connect, handle 404 as no CIMD, parse JSON), add CIMD schema (Zod schema with protocol version string, capabilities array [tools, resources, prompts, sampling], deprecated APIs array with API name + sunset date, experimental features array), add compatibility validator (src/mcp/compatibility.ts, check protocol version semver compatibility, reject if major mismatch, compute capability intersection, warn on deprecated APIs), integrate into MCP client connect flow (src/mcp/client.ts, fetch CIMD before connect, validate compatibility, store CIMD per server), add mcp-servers.json CIMD cache (optional field per server, TTL-based revalidation), write tests (CIMD fetch success/404, version mismatch rejection, capability intersection, deprecated API warning, experimental feature detection).

#### 2. Cline #14462 model-list error surfacing - MEDIUM PRIORITY (provider + cli)

- **What**: Cline PR #14462 "fix(desktop): surface model-list failures and trust the OS certificate store" merged 2026-09-24 fixed model list error handling (endpoint-owned model lists for private-catalog providers like LiteLLM, Baseten, Ollama, LM Studio silently returned empty list on fetch failure - unreachable host, TLS rejection, bad key; fix propagates fetch error to UI so Settings panel shows 'Failed to fetch models: <reason>' instead of 'no models'; also added --use-system-ca to Bun compiled sidecar so OS cert store trusted for intranet endpoints). This is error surfacing (model list fetch failures propagate instead of silent empty list).

- **Why**: Alexi fetches models from SAP AI Core / proxy endpoints (src/providers/index.ts, getProviderForModel, src/providers/modelCatalog.ts), and may silently return empty lists on fetch failures (unreachable endpoint, auth failure, TLS rejection). Cline's fix propagates fetch errors to the UI so users see why model list is empty (bad API key, unreachable host, cert error) instead of 'no models available'. Implementation path: audit model list fetching (src/providers/modelCatalog.ts, src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts, check if fetch failures surface or return empty array), propagate fetch errors (throw or return error object instead of []), surface errors in CLI commands (src/cli/commands/models.ts, show error message instead of empty list), add retry logic for transient errors (network timeout, 5xx), write tests (model list fetch failure surfaces error, transient errors retried, TLS rejection surfaced).

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/14462 (Cline model-list error surfacing, merged 2026-09-24), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/providers/modelCatalog.ts (Alexi model catalog, audit error handling), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/cli/commands/models.ts (models CLI command)

- **Category**: provider + cli (model list error handling)

- **Size**: SMALL (~2-4h). Audit model list fetching (src/providers/modelCatalog.ts, src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts, find fetch calls, check if errors caught and swallowed), propagate fetch errors (throw with descriptive message or return {error, models: []}), surface errors in CLI (src/cli/commands/models.ts, check if error displayed or only empty list), add retry for transient errors (use existing ErrorBackoff from src/core/error-backoff.ts, retry on 502/503/429/ECONNRESET), write tests (model list fetch failure throws/returns error, transient error retried, permanent error surfaces immediately, empty list vs error distinguished).

#### 3. Cline #14239 silent command output rendering - LOW PRIORITY (tui + tool)

- **What**: Cline PR #14239 "fix(vscode): stop rendering the raw tool envelope for silent commands" merged 2026-09-24 fixed tool output rendering (commands with empty result were rendered as raw JSON envelope `[{"query":"git add -A","result":"","success":true}]` instead of silent; extractToolOutputText only recognized non-empty result or error, so empty-string result fell through to JSON.stringify fallback; fix treats empty-string result as recognized, empty output). This is TUI rendering fix (silent commands render without output section, not raw JSON).

- **Why**: Alexi has TUI (src/cli/tui/) and tool output rendering (src/tool/tools/ emit results, TUI displays them). Commands with no output (e.g. `git add -A`, `rm file.txt`) may render as raw JSON envelope instead of silent/collapsed. Low priority (cosmetic TUI issue, does not affect functionality; audit needed to confirm extractToolOutputText pattern exists). Implementation path: audit tool output rendering (src/cli/tui/, find tool result display logic), check if empty-string results fall through to JSON.stringify, treat empty-string result as recognized/silent (render command row with no output section or collapsed), write test (silent command renders without JSON envelope).

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/14239 (Cline silent command rendering fix, merged 2026-09-24), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/cli/tui/ (Alexi TUI rendering)

- **Category**: tui + tool (tool output rendering, empty result handling)

- **Size**: SMALL (~1-2h). Audit tool output rendering (src/cli/tui/, find tool result display, check if extractToolOutputText or similar pattern exists), if empty-string results fall through to JSON.stringify, add empty-string recognition (treat `{result: ""}` as silent, render command row with no output or collapsed section), write test (tool with empty result renders silently, not as JSON envelope).
